rows.en:
(I wonder if Saotome-kun has some special feelings
about the sky...)

Oh, it's you, \p.
You're a weird one too, coming up to the roof again.
That's rich, coming from you, Alto.
Haha, fair enough.

A new planet... Maybe it won't be long
before we find one...
Hm, maybe so...
(Is Alto sensing something?)
(Looks like Saotome-kun's up on the roof again...)
Hi, Saotome-kun. You're here again?
That's rich, coming from you, Saotome-kun.
Hm, maybe so...
(Is Saotome-kun sensing something?)
Come on, what are you dawdling for?!
Hold on, it's not going anywhere, is it?

\p.
Do you even want to do this?

Of course!
See, I'm ready. Let's go!
Whew~ The sky really does feel amazing!

Yeah. The horizon, white clouds...
A real, free sky!

Come on, let's go!
If you keep trailing behind me like that,
you won't even get the chance to be in my way!
rows.notes: Callback to c04069 ('just don't get in my way'): lagging behind, the player would not even get in Alto's way.

rows.en: Whoa, whoa, you're going way too fast...

This is nothing yet!
Now, let's gooooo!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Alto (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_alt_009 female branch and frd_alt_010 male branch, the gender branches that each scene does not use). Translated literally; Affinity as in terms.json.

rows.en: Hold on, it's not going anywhere, is it?

Yeah. The horizon, white clouds...
A real, free sky!
Geez! You're going way too fast...

(Okay, school's over. Maybe I'll unwind and go
to Nyan-Nyan with someone...)
rows.notes: Shared by six characters' invitation scenes, both genders.

rows.en:
(Oh, there's Alto. Perfect timing.
I'll go ask him.)

Hm, \p?
What's up?

Well, want to go to Nyan-Nyan with me
after this? I was just wondering...
rows.notes: Shared by the Alto, Nanase, Sheryl and Yuu scenes (male player): no pronoun for the listener.

rows.en:
Hm? Ah, sorry.
I've got something to do after this...
Oh, I see...
rows.notes: Used 97 times by both player genders.

rows.en: Ask me again some other time. See ya.
(Guess we're still not that close...)
rows.notes: Shared by the Alto, Nanase and Yuu scenes: no pronoun for the other person.

rows.en:
(Oh, there's Saotome-kun. Perfect timing.
I'll go ask him.)

Well, want to go to Nyan-Nyan with me
after this? I was just wondering...
rows.notes: Shared by the Alto, Nanase and Yuu scenes (female player).

rows.en:
(Okay, school's over. Maybe I'll unwind and go
to the Observation Pier with someone...)
rows.notes: Observation Pier as in the campus place list (u4355).

rows.en:
Well, want to go to the Observation Pier with me
after this? I was just wondering...

Hm, there of all places?
I'm not really feeling it. I'll pass.
Sorry. Invite me again sometime. See ya.
(Maybe I picked the wrong place...)

Well, want to go to the Observation Pier with me
after this? I was just wondering...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to go see
the Macross Quarter.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Macross Quarter with me this weekend...

The Macross Quarter, huh...
It's not that I'm not interested...
But I'll pass this time.
(Guess the Macross Quarter was a bit much...)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Macross Quarter with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to go shopping at Folmo.)
rows.notes: Folmo as in the campus place list (u4332).

rows.en:
Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping at Folmo with me this weekend...

Folmo, huh? Not bad.
But I've got something to do this weekend.
(Maybe my timing was bad...)
rows.notes: Used 44 times by both player genders.

rows.en:
Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping at Folmo with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to go shopping at "199.")
rows.notes: Store name written with full-width digits in quotes; not in the glossary or the campus place list. Kept as "199".

rows.en:
Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to "199" with me this weekend...

"199," huh? Not bad.
But I've got something to do this weekend.

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to "199" with me this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to the artificial island.)
rows.notes: Aligned: 'the artificial island' lowercase in dialogue (glossary).

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to the artificial island with me this weekend...
rows.notes: Aligned: 'the artificial island' lowercase in dialogue (glossary).

rows.en:
The Artificial Island, huh...
It's not bad, but I dunno...

(Maybe I should wait until we're
a little closer...)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
to the Artificial Island with me this weekend...

(Maybe I should wait until we're
a little closer...)
I see...
rows.notes: Shared by both player genders and Yamashiro.
